item.title: [Score 82] Provision of Community Sports Equipment & Outdoor Fitness Stations
item.description: Opportunity score: 82/100. Contract value: £25,000.00. Deadline: 2026-11-25 23:59 UTC. Positive indicators: installation, training, value within target range. Risks/checks required: None. Original notice: https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Notice/109934-2026. Advertised value: GBP 25,000 Status: active Deadline: 2026-11-25T23:59:00+00:00 Westminster City Council is seeking to appoint suppliers for the provision, installation, operation and maintenance of community sport and wellbeing infrastructure across Westminster. The procurement comprises two lots: (1) app-enabled community sports equipment access and locker stations providing free access to sports equipment through a digital platform, and (2) outdoor fitness stations and wellbeing infrastructure providing free-to-use exercise and strength-training opportunities within public spaces. The services aim to increase participation in sport and physical activity, improve accessibility, support community wellbeing and generate measurable social value and usage outcomes across the borough.
